parameter_definition: Maximum absolute difference per[Teff K,logg cgs dex,MH dex,vsini km/s] divided by independent original full-posterior standard deviation.
nrmse_definition: RMS error over all52570 complete modelled spectral-window flux samples divided by dynamic range of independently reproduced original spectrum; no alignment or scaling.
observation_definition: RMS over all3643 selected Fe-mask entries, retaining original mask concatenation, of(predicted spectrum minus measured flux)/original independently estimated run-time noise map. This is standard-method weighting, not independent instrument variance.
reference_type: Validated independently reproduced standard method; no physical ground truth
tolerance_provenance: Parameter3sigma and weightedRMSE1.1ratio preselected in stepar_binding_frozen.json before local inverse; full-spectrum nonzero0.001dynamic tolerance fixed here before local inverse based on source posterior measurement scale, to be checked against independent source rerun, never tuned to cleaned output.
